requirements.text: The system should allow students to search for items and check availability.
Students should be able to borrow and return items online.
Students should be able to book study rooms online without needing to visit the desk.
The system must automatically calculate late fines for overdue items.
Students should be able to view their current loans, due dates, and any fines they have.
The system should send email notifications to students about fines immediately after they are applied.
The system should restrict borrowing and room booking capabilities for students with outstanding fines.
Librarians should have the ability to intervene in cases of fines and discuss issues with students.
Students should be able to select room capacity when booking study rooms.
Librarians should manage issues such as double bookings and special requests for study room bookings.
The system must ensure that students with outstanding fines cannot make study room bookings.
